scene: You step onto the wooden pier of glowing Jade Junk Harbour.
picture: Side-scrolling view along a level wooden dock above green water. Far left, the glowing solar-sail junk and a roofed tea barge float tied up. Left of centre stands the top-knotted player in floral shirt with his ukulele. Right of centre stands a brass dockworker automaton. Far right stands a tall pagoda lighthouse with red balconies.
shown: a roofed tea barge bobbing on the green water on the far left
a tall red pagoda lighthouse with a spiral stair on the far right
a brass robotic dockworker holding coiled rope to the right of centre
